subject: Sequenced quality rollout & evaluation integration — Northbound Health

From: Emma Lane <emma.lane@northboundhealth.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: quality monitoring plan for NPX launch

Sean / Rafael —

Thanks for arranging time earlier. As discussed, Northbound Health is planning to go live with the NPX triage assistant in March. Before we flip traffic we need a clear handoff plan for production quality monitoring: prompt sets for core intents, an eval harness integrated into our CI, regression alerts, and canary / rollback policy that our ops team can follow.

To make this concrete, could you:
- Confirm the suggested telemetry and alert thresholds for intent drift and hallucination rate
- Share the recommended structure for prompt sets and versioning (we need to lock v1)
- Outline how you plan to integrate the eval harness with our Jenkins pipeline and the expected cadence for scheduled runs
- Provide a canary test matrix and rollback playbook we can review with ops

Attached is our initial scope workbook (NBH_QA_scope.xlsx) with current intents and sample conversations. We can host the first sync next week; prefer Tue or Wed mornings PST.

Thanks,
Emma Lane
Head of Product
Northbound Health

Subject: Re: Kickoff: quality monitoring plan for NPX launch

Emma —

Thanks for the clear scope and the workbook. Quick acknowledgement and a proposed sequencing below — happy to take a 30-minute sync Tue 12/22 10am PST if that works.

Proposed sequencing (high level):
1) Prompt set lock (v1): Redwood & NBH agree on 4 canonical prompt groups (intake, triage, escalation, fallback). We will version via promptset_v1.jsonl and store in a shared Drive folder.
2) Eval harness integration: we’ll provide a short-run harness that runs your sample set + edge-case augmentations; plan to integrate as a Jenkins job that triggers nightly and before any canary push.
3) Regression alerts & thresholds: start conservative — alert if intent F1 drops >8% from baseline or hallucination score >3% on curated test set; escalate to on-call CS then to engineering if persistent for 2 runs.
4) Canary matrix & rollback: canary slices by region & model variant (latency/cost profile); automatic rollback trigger on sustained metric regressions (3 consecutive failing buckets) plus manual review gate.

I attached a 1-page outline to use as the kickoff artifact.

Next steps: confirm Tue 12/22 10am PST or propose another slot; Rafael — adding you for deal/contract timeline alignment. Marissa / Jonas — please review the sequence and flag any operational gaps (especially around alert destinations and runbooks).

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: cs-rollout-outline.pdf (one-page stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lane <emma.lane@northboundhealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: quality monitoring plan for NPX launch

Team / Emma —

Following up with a proposed implementation playbook (detailed steps). I’m putting the essentials here so ops/engineering can start planning before the sync: 

A) Prompt sets & versioning
- Deliverable: promptset_v1.jsonl (we will provide a JSONL of canonical prompts + example responses). Version tag: nbx-v1.0.
- Owner: NBH product + Redwood CS for labeling.
- Storage: shared Drive path (we will add write permissions for NBH content owners).

B) Eval harness integration (CI)
- Deliverable: eval_harness_playbook.md (contains runner script, metrics extraction, and CI job snippet).
- Integration steps:
  1. Redwood provides harness repo and a Jenkinsfile snippet.
  2. NBH adds credentials to a service account in your Jenkins (read-only artifact push).
  3. Nightly runs with seeded augmentations; pre-canary smoke runs on PRs.
- Success criteria: nightly run completes within SLA (<= 45 min) and reports baseline metrics to the alerts system.

C) Regression alerts & thresholds
- Baseline metrics to monitor: intent F1, slot extraction F1, hallucination rate (heuristic), average confidence delta.
- Initial thresholds (conservative):
  • Intent F1 drop >8% relative to locked baseline
  • Hallucination rate >3% absolute on curated set
  • Latency p95 degradation >25%
- Alert routing: PagerDuty NBH-ops escalation -> Redwood-CS on-call (page) -> Redwood-eng if unresolved after 2 runs.

D) Canary matrix and rollback policy
- Canary slices: 1) internal test traffic (10%), 2) a single small customer cohort (5%), 3) regional slice (us-west).
- Canary evaluation window: 6 hours per slice with aggregated metrics and a manual review after the window.
- Automatic rollback: triggered if 3 consecutive runs in a slice exceed threshold OR if a critical regression (intent F1 drop >12%) occurs. Manual review required before full rollout.

E) Artifacts and attachments (stubs)
- promptset_v1.jsonl — canonical prompts + labels
- eval_harness_playbook.md — CI integration steps and metric collection
- canary_matrix.csv — suggested slicing and metrics mapping

F) Open questions for the sync
- Confirm who will own the Jenkins service account on NBH side.
- Agree on initial seed size for the curated test set (we recommend 5k examples).
- Confirm alert destinations and escalation window (is PagerDuty configured?).

I’ll drop the playbook into the Drive folder and link it to this thread. If everyone is good, I’ll also add the runbook snippets to a shared repo and open the first PR for the Jenkinsfile.

On an internal note: Sean — let’s ensure the CS can run the initial harness next Mon in staging (need CI creds). Jonas — can you scope the onboarding tasks for the infra team?

—Marissa
Manager, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: promptset_v1.jsonl (stub), eval_harness_playbook.md (stub), canary_matrix.csv (stub)

Marissa / Sean / Team —

- Jenkins creds: Carlos (cc’d) will own the Jenkins service account; he will need the runbook and the snippet you mentioned.
- PagerDuty: confirmed — NBH will map alerts to our ops PD and we’ll add Redwood-CS as a secondary escalation.

Approval: We’re happy to sign off on the conservative thresholds and the canary slices as proposed. Please proceed with creating the Drive folder and the repo PRs so we can begin the staging run.

Next meeting: Tue 12/29 10am PST for a tabletop and staging run walkthrough (Carlos will bring the ops lead).

Thanks all — Emma
